What We Deliver

From scan to publication-
ready plan in 48 hours

Every deliverable is branded, dimensioned, and ready for portals, brochures, or developer submissions.

⬛

2D Floorplans

Clean black & white or colour-coded layouts with accurate room dimensions, labels, and door/window positions. Agency logo applied as standard on Premium and above.

◈

3D Rendered Plans

Photo-realistic bird's-eye renders with furniture, fixtures, and outdoor areas shown. The format preferred by top-tier luxury portals and international buyers.

▶

Candid Video Walkthroughs

Smooth 2–3 minute on-site tours filmed and edited for Instagram Reels, agency websites, and listing portals — shot on gimbal for cinematic quality.

⬡

Site & Plot Plans

Full property grounds including pool, terraces, garden, and parking. Essential for larger fincas and villas where the outdoor space is part of the proposition.

↕

Multi-Level Plans

Separate floor-by-floor plans plus a combined overview for two or three-storey villas. Each level clearly differentiated with consistent labelling and scale.

📐

CAD Files & Developer Packs

Editable .dwg and .dxf files for architects, planners, and developers. Includes print-ready CMYK PDFs and all source files for planning submissions.

How It Works

Booked, scanned, delivered

A simple three-step process designed around your schedule and your property manager's time.

01

Book a Visit

Send us the property address and a preferred scan time. We confirm within the hour and arrive on time with full equipment — no setup delays.

02

On-Site Scan

We scan every room using MagicPlan phone technology and a laser measure. A typical four-bedroom villa takes 45–60 minutes. No disruption to guests or owners.

03

Plan Production

Raw scan data is refined, labelled, dimensioned, and branded. We apply your agency logo, colour palette, and any specific formatting your portals require.

04

Delivery & Revisions

Files arrive by email as high-resolution PDF and PNG within your agreed turnaround window. One round of revisions included in every package.
